limitations: The source leaves the terminal outcome ambiguous when an already-recorded promise is followed by a later paid, dispute, hardship-decline, refusal, or service-error event; it specifies precedence only for a later transfer. No precedence was invented.

Deterministic enforcement of calendar calculations, amount floors, confirmation revision invalidation, and retry counts is not implemented in this compact patch; the existing workflow describes these in dialogue/tool instructions rather than backend-established code state.
Callback, identity, promise-write, and transfer failure handling remains dependent on tool results and dialogue instructions; no live workflow or API behavior was tested.
